suggestions: Retain the geometry-based anchor and transparent-padding compensation.
Keep the action panel background owned by the shared Manager HUD so duplicate scene backdrops do not return.
Preserve the independent Reset, panel-bottom, and Manager-section offsets when tuning future spacing.
Keep the explicit panel-relative left anchor for the Manager label at alternate display scales.
reasoning: The final spacing is balanced: Reset sits higher without moving the selector or upper panel controls, the panel grows only at the bottom, and a clearly visible gap separates the red dataset icon from Hire a Manager. The larger hat remains easy to drag and the Manager section stays fully contained across all five levels.
